-- Auto Win Battle
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    :WaitForChild("Remotes")
    :WaitForChild("AttackBoss")

while true do
    remote:FireServer()
    task.wait(0.1) -- Slows it down slightly (10 times per second)
end


-- Auto Lick
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    :WaitForChild("Remotes")
    :WaitForChild("Lick")

while task.wait() do
    remote:FireServer()
end

-- Auto Rebirth 
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    :WaitForChild("Remotes")
    :WaitForChild("Rebirth")

while true do
    remote:FireServer()
    task.wait(0.25) -- Adjust this delay to control speed
end
